title: 王焕与邢程获第四届EOAS学术沙龙优秀墙报奖
summary: 第四届地球与海洋大气科学学术沙龙于10月16日至18日在港科大（广州）举办，聚焦气候变化背景下的地球系统与人类社会。课题组王焕、邢程获优秀墙报奖，与来自二十余所高校及科研院所的学者交流。
image_alt: 第四届EOAS学术沙龙优秀墙报奖颁奖合照
title_en: Huan WANG and Cheng XING win poster awards at the fourth EOAS Academic Salon
summary_en: Huan WANG and Cheng XING received Outstanding Poster Awards at the fourth EOAS Academic Salon, held at HKUST(GZ) on 16–18 October. The event brought together scholars from more than 20 universities and research institutes to discuss Earth systems and society under climate change.
image_alt_en: Outstanding Poster Award recipients at the fourth EOAS Academic Salon

title: 王焕获复旦–ACS环境论坛优秀海报奖
summary: 博士生王焕在复旦–ACS环境论坛展示碳酸盐矿物沉淀促进河流微塑料沉降的研究，获 ACS Publications 优秀海报奖。该研究关注自然地质过程对陆源微塑料向海输送的调控作用。
image_alt: 王焕在复旦–ACS环境论坛的获奖照片
title_en: Huan WANG receives an ACS Publications Outstanding Poster Award
summary_en: Huan WANG presented research on carbonate mineral precipitation and microplastic deposition at the Fudan–ACS Environmental Forum, receiving an Outstanding Poster Award.
image_alt_en: Huan WANG holding her poster award at the Fudan–ACS Environmental Forum

title: 刘易老师获批国家自然科学基金面上项目
summary: 刘易老师申报的“地质背景调控河流生态系统新陈代谢的机制及效应研究”获批2026年国家自然科学基金面上项目。该项目是本年度功能枢纽获批项目之一。
image_alt: 刘易老师照片
title_en: Yi LIU awarded an NSFC General Program project
summary_en: The project on geological regulation of river ecosystem metabolism was awarded funding under the 2026 NSFC General Program, as part of the Function Hub’s successful applications.
image_alt_en: Yi LIU, principal investigator of the LogScience Lab

title: 祝贺Yuke LI与Xinke LI通过MPhil论文答辩并顺利毕业
summary: Yuke LI与Xinke LI分别于7月24日和25日完成MPhil论文答辩，并顺利从港科大（广州）毕业。两项研究分别关注大湾区小水体的碳排放，以及河口系统中的微塑料输移。
image_alt: Yuke LI在MPhil论文答辩后的合照
title_en: Congratulations to Yuke LI and Xinke LI on their MPhil defenses and graduation
summary_en: Yuke LI and Xinke LI successfully defended their MPhil theses on 24 and 25 July and have graduated from HKUST(GZ). Their work examines greenhouse-gas emissions from small water bodies in the Greater Bay Area and microplastic transport in a coastal river–estuary system.
image_alt_en: Yuke LI with her thesis examination committee after her MPhil defense

gallery.image_alt: Yuke LI with her thesis examination committee after her MPhil defense
gallery.caption: Yuke LI · MPhil thesis defense · 24 Jul 2026

gallery.image_alt: Xinke LI with her thesis examination committee after her MPhil defense
gallery.caption: Xinke LI · MPhil thesis defense · 25 Jul 2026

title: 我们揭示土地利用、点源与潮汐对河口微塑料迁移的共同作用
summary: 团队以镇海湾河口为对象，结合现场采样、土地利用分析与潮汐水动力研究，揭示微塑料输入、沉积储存和再悬浮的过程。成果发表于 Journal of Hazardous Materials。
image_alt: 土地利用、潮汐与河口微塑料迁移机制示意图
title_en: Tracing microplastic transport through a coastal river–estuary system
summary_en: Our study in Zhenhai Bay examines how land use, point sources and tides jointly regulate microplastic inputs, sediment storage and remobilization. Published in Journal of Hazardous Materials.
image_alt_en: Conceptual illustration of land use, tides and estuarine microplastic transport

title: 我们揭示潮汐与含水层异质性如何调控沙滩无机氮
summary: 团队通过高分辨率地下水监测与同位素培养实验，研究潮汐变化和沉积物异质性对无机氮分层、转化及入海通量的协同影响。成果发表于 Journal of Hydrology。
image_alt: 沙滩无机氮研究区及地下水监测布设图
title_en: Tides and aquifer heterogeneity shape nitrogen dynamics in sandy beaches
summary_en: High-resolution groundwater monitoring and isotope experiments reveal how tides and sediment heterogeneity influence nitrogen transformations and coastal export. Published in Journal of Hydrology.
image_alt_en: Coastal study area and groundwater monitoring arrangement

title: 李雨珂获流域碳中和学术大会优秀口头报告奖
summary: 红鸟硕士生李雨珂在第二届流域碳中和学术大会作报告，获研究生论坛优秀口头报告奖。研究基于课题组大湾区野外调查，评估小型水体的二氧化碳与甲烷排放。
image_alt: 李雨珂在第二届流域碳中和学术大会作报告
title_en: Yuke LI receives an outstanding oral presentation award
summary_en: Yuke LI presented Greater Bay Area small-water-body greenhouse gas research at the Second Watershed Carbon Neutrality Conference, receiving an outstanding oral presentation award in the graduate forum.
image_alt_en: Yuke LI presenting at the Second Watershed Carbon Neutrality Conference

title: 碳审计技能培训：从蓝碳、绿碳到城市排放核算
summary: 在港科大（广州）举办的碳审计培训邀请香港与内地专家，围绕海草床蓝碳、林业碳汇数字化及城市碳排放核算，向企业人员和学生介绍方法与实操流程。
image_alt: 碳审计培训中介绍海草床蓝碳调查方法的现场
title_en: Carbon auditing: connecting methods with practice
summary_en: A training workshop at HKUST(GZ) brought together experts from Hong Kong and mainland China to discuss seagrass blue carbon, digital forestry carbon accounting and urban emissions inventories.
image_alt_en: Speaker presenting blue-carbon survey methods at a carbon-auditing workshop

title: 刘易老师与师生参与碳中和审计与政策学术交流
summary: 港科大（广州）与香港科大联合举办碳中和审计与政策会议，刘易老师致开幕辞，李雨珂分享大湾区小水体温室气体研究。会议围绕自然碳排放、能源转型与碳核算展开交流。
image_alt: 碳中和审计与政策会议参会人员合照
title_en: Sharing research on carbon auditing and climate policy
summary_en: At a joint HKUST(GZ)–HKUST meeting, Yi LIU delivered opening remarks and Yuke LI presented small-water-body greenhouse gas research. Discussions covered natural emissions, energy transitions and carbon accounting.
image_alt_en: Participants at the carbon auditing and policy meeting

title: 我们揭示全球河流氧化亚氮排放风险的地质调控机制
summary: 团队结合珠江流域实验与全球数据分析，揭示基岩类型如何通过沉积物和水体环境影响反硝化及氧化亚氮排放风险。成果发表于 Communications Earth & Environment。
image_alt: 碳酸盐岩与硅酸盐岩区域河流氧化亚氮生成机制示意图
title_en: Geological controls on riverine nitrous oxide emission risks
summary_en: Combining Pearl River Basin experiments and global data, our research links bedrock geology, sediments and water chemistry with denitrification and nitrous oxide risks. Published in Communications Earth & Environment.
image_alt_en: Geological controls on riverine nitrous oxide generation

title: 庄钧懿、姜瑞雪与刘易的潜流带氮循环综述获Water Research接受
summary: 该综述系统梳理河流潜流带的水文交换、氮转化及其与碳、铁、锰循环的耦合，讨论潜流带如何在氮源与氮汇之间转换，以及这些过程对水质管理和生态修复的意义。日期采用论文接受时间；推文发表于2026年3月12日。
image_alt: 河流水位变化驱动潜流带氮源汇功能转换的示意图
title_en: A systematic review of hyporheic nitrogen cycling is accepted by Water Research
summary_en: Junyi ZHUANG, Ruixue JIANG and Yi LIU review how hydrological exchange, nitrogen transformations and coupled carbon–iron–manganese processes shape the hyporheic zone as a nitrogen source or sink, with implications for water quality and river restoration. Dated by acceptance; the linked feature appeared on 12 March 2026.
image_alt_en: Conceptual illustration of hydrological changes and nitrogen source–sink functions in the hyporheic zone

title: 我们揭示沙滩铁矿物分布及其对磷污染的截留作用
summary: 团队刻画高渗透性沙滩铁矿物的丰度、组成和空间分布，探讨铁矿物形成及其截留陆源磷的作用，为认识海岸带污染物自然衰减提供依据。成果发表于 Chemical Geology。
image_alt: 海岸沙滩铁矿物形成与磷截留机制示意图
title_en: Iron minerals and phosphorus retention in permeable sandy beaches
summary_en: Our study examines the abundance, composition and distribution of beach iron minerals and their role in retaining land-derived phosphorus. Published in Chemical Geology.
image_alt_en: Iron cycling and phosphorus retention in a permeable beach aquifer

title: 祁虹凯博士毕业专访：把论文写在祖国大地上
summary: 学校专访2025届博士毕业生祁虹凯，回顾他在刘易老师指导下参与珠江流域、大湾区及中国海岸线调查的经历，分享从野外观测走向 Nature Geoscience 研究成果的成长故事。
image_alt: Hongkai QI身穿毕业礼服的照片
title_en: Hongkai QI reflects on fieldwork and doctoral research
summary_en: A university graduate interview follows Hongkai QI’s research journey through Pearl River, Greater Bay Area and coastal China field investigations, including the work behind his Nature Geoscience publication.
image_alt_en: Hongkai QI in graduation robes

title: 我们完成粤港澳大湾区小型水体科学考察
summary: 课题组历时30余天走访大湾区9个地级市的小型水体，采集水样、沉积物及环境参数，研究温室气体动态与人类活动的影响，为区域水体碳排放评估积累基础数据。
image_alt: 大湾区小型水体科学考察中的不同类型水体
title_en: Surveying small water bodies across the Greater Bay Area
summary_en: The team completed a survey across nine mainland cities over more than 30 days, collecting water, sediment and environmental data to study greenhouse gas dynamics and human influences.
image_alt_en: Examples of small water bodies surveyed in the Greater Bay Area

title: 祁虹凯获第七届岩溶科学青年论坛优秀学术报告奖
summary: 博士生祁虹凯在重庆举行的岩溶科学青年论坛报告碳酸盐岩风化增强河流氮同化的研究，获优秀学术报告奖。相关成果以祁虹凯为第一作者发表于 Nature Geoscience。
image_alt: 祁虹凯在第七届岩溶科学青年论坛作报告
title_en: Hongkai QI receives an outstanding academic presentation award
summary_en: Hongkai QI presented research on carbonate weathering and riverine nitrogen assimilation at the Seventh Young Scientists Forum on Karst Science in Chongqing, receiving an outstanding academic presentation award.
image_alt_en: Hongkai QI presenting at the Young Scientists Forum on Karst Science

title: 我们联合四方团队启动中国海岸带小流域科考
summary: 刘易老师团队携手香港科大何丁、吴龙君老师及深圳大学周之超老师团队，以广西至辽宁超过180个海岸带小流域为对象，开展水文、地球化学与微生物生态的跨学科调查。
image_alt: 中国海岸带小流域科学考察团队出发合照
title_en: Launching a collaborative survey of China’s coastal watersheds
summary_en: Yi LIU’s team joined Ding He and Longjun Wu at HKUST and Zhichao Zhou at Shenzhen University to investigate more than 180 small coastal watersheds from Guangxi to Liaoning.
image_alt_en: The coastal watershed field team before departure

title: 我们与香港大学合作揭示潮间带镭同位素的季节变化
summary: 团队联合香港大学焦赳赳老师团队，通过长期野外观测研究海岸带镭同位素的时空分布与迁移，为海底地下水排泄示踪提供依据。成果发表于 JGR: Oceans。
image_alt: 潮间带地下水流动与镭同位素迁移示意图
title_en: Seasonal radium dynamics in an intertidal aquifer
summary_en: In collaboration with Jiu Jimmy Jiao’s group at HKU, our research examines the distribution and transport of radium isotopes to support submarine groundwater discharge tracing. Published in JGR: Oceans.
image_alt_en: Groundwater flow and radium isotope transport schematic

title: 我们的河流氮循环研究发表于 Nature Geoscience
summary: 团队揭示碳酸盐岩风化通过调控溶解无机碳增强河流氮同化吸收的机制，将珠江流域与国际合作调查拓展到全球河流分析，增进对地质背景与碳氮耦合循环的理解。
image_alt: 碳酸盐岩风化促进河流氮同化吸收机制示意图
title_en: Carbonate weathering enhances nitrogen uptake in rivers
summary_en: Our Nature Geoscience study connects Pearl River Basin and international field investigations with global analysis, revealing how dissolved inorganic carbon links carbonate weathering with riverine nitrogen assimilation.
image_alt_en: Carbonate weathering and riverine nitrogen uptake schematic

title: 我们与先进材料团队合作研究珠江流域微塑料污染
summary: 刘易老师团队与王军老师合作，调查珠江流域微塑料的空间分布、潜在来源及迁移路径，探讨水动力对颗粒沉降与去除的影响。成果发表于 Water Research。
image_alt: 珠江流域微塑料来源与迁移路径图形摘要
title_en: Investigating microplastic pollution in the Pearl River network
summary_en: Working with Jun Wang’s advanced materials team, we investigated microplastic distributions, potential sources and migration pathways, including hydrodynamic effects on particle settling. Published in Water Research.
image_alt_en: Graphical abstract of Pearl River microplastic sources and transport

title: 我们与香港科大合作研究潜流交换对河流甲烷排放的影响
summary: 团队与香港科大陆萌茜老师团队合作，研究珠江流域甲烷的时空变化，揭示潜流层作为甲烷生成场所与传输通道的作用。成果发表于 Journal of Hydrology。
image_alt: 珠江流域河流与潜流层甲烷研究采样点分布图
title_en: Hyporheic exchange and methane emissions from rivers
summary_en: A collaboration with Mengqian Lu’s group at HKUST examines the hyporheic zone as both a methane production environment and a transport pathway. Published in Journal of Hydrology.
image_alt_en: Pearl River methane study sampling locations

title: 我们与香港科大合作揭示珠江流域碳排放机制
summary: 刘易老师团队联合陆萌茜老师团队，研究珠江河网二氧化碳逸散过程，揭示碳酸盐岩风化与潜流交换对河流碳通量的控制作用。成果发表于 Water Research。
image_alt: 珠江流域碳通量研究采样点分布图
title_en: Understanding carbon fluxes in the Pearl River Basin
summary_en: Our collaboration with Mengqian Lu’s group at HKUST examines how carbonate weathering and hyporheic exchange influence riverine carbon dioxide evasion. Published in Water Research.
image_alt_en: Pearl River Basin carbon study sampling locations

title: 祁虹凯博士资格考试报告：河网中的硝酸盐去除与滞留
summary: 祁虹凯的博士资格考试公告介绍河网硝酸盐去除与滞留研究，关注地质过程、地下水流和潜流交换等地下过程对氮循环的影响；指导老师为刘易与甘剑平。
image_alt: 祁虹凯博士资格考试报告海报
title_en: Hongkai QI’s PhD qualifying examination announcement
summary_en: The announcement introduces Hongkai QI’s research on nitrate removal and retention in river networks, with attention to geological processes, groundwater flow and hyporheic exchange. Supervisors: Yi LIU and Jianping Gan.
image_alt_en: Hongkai QI’s PhD qualifying examination announcement poster

title: 《明报》报道我们的珠江流域溯源科考
summary: 《明报》报道刘易老师带领学生跨越6省区、行程约1.5万公里的珠江流域调查，介绍团队采集河流与地下水数据、开展跨学科合作的经历。
image_alt: 明报珠江科考报道中的刘易老师照片
title_en: Ming Pao features our Pearl River field investigations
summary_en: Ming Pao reported on the team’s journey across six provinces and approximately 15,000 km to collect river and groundwater observations, highlighting field research and cross-disciplinary collaboration.
image_alt_en: Yi LIU photographed for Ming Pao’s Pearl River fieldwork report

title: 刘易老师与祁虹凯参加 EGU 2023 年会
summary: 刘易老师与博士生祁虹凯同 EOAS 迟进舒老师赴维也纳参加欧洲地球科学联合会年会。刘易老师分享地下水排泄与近岸酸化研究，师生围绕水文及地球系统问题开展交流。
image_alt: 刘易、祁虹凯与迟进舒参加 EGU 2023 年会合照
title_en: Sharing our research at EGU 2023
summary_en: Yi LIU and Hongkai QI joined EOAS colleague Jinshu Chi in Vienna for the EGU General Assembly. Yi LIU presented research on submarine groundwater discharge and coastal acidification.
image_alt_en: Yi LIU, Hongkai QI and Jinshu Chi at EGU 2023

title: 我们完成珠江全流域旱季科学考察
summary: 刘易老师带领学生跨越珠江流域6省区，完成200多个站点的调查与采样，收集地表水、地下水、沉积物及气体等数据，为研究流域水文与污染物迁移转化奠定基础。
image_alt: 珠江全流域旱季科学考察小组成员合照
title_en: Completing a dry-season survey of the Pearl River Basin
summary_en: The team surveyed more than 200 sites across six provinces, collecting surface water, groundwater, sediments and gas samples to investigate basin-scale hydrology and contaminant transport.
image_alt_en: Team members during the Pearl River dry-season field survey
